A slip: a printed strip showing the card type line and its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-imperialreinforcements-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Imperial Reinforcements]]: The game text changes: “outnumbers you in” becomes “has more”; “than you have,” is added; “Retrieve” is added; “TIE fighters may be retrieved from Lost Pile.” becomes “TIE/lns.”. These are the same words as [[Imperial Reinforcements (Decipher Errata 2002)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with a title and a white italic “E”.

The same area of the printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
